senses.gloss:
आ-खु, उस्, m. a mouse, a rat, a mole; the grass
Lipeocercis Serrata; a thief; a hog; a digger, a
spade.
—आखु-करीष, अम्, n., Ved. a mole-hill.
—आखु-कर्णी, f., N. of the plant Salvinia Cucul-
lata.
—आखु-ग, अस्, m. (riding on a rat), an epithet
of Gaṇeśa and of Kārttikeya.
—आखु-घात, अस्, m.
a Śūdra or man of low caste and profession, lit. ‘a rat-
catcher.’
—आखु-पर्णिका or आखु-पर्णी, f., N. of
the plant Salvinia Cucullata Roxb. (?).
—आखु-पा-
षाण, अस्, m. a kind of mineral, a loadstone.
—आखु-भुज्, क्, m. ‘a mouse-eater,’ a cat.
—आखु-
रथ, अस्, m. a N. of Gaṇeśa, ‘having a rat for his
vehicle.’
—आखु-विष-हा, f. a kind of grass, Andro-
pogon Serratum, considered as a remedy for a rat's
bite.
—आखूत्कर (˚खु-उत्˚), अस्, m. a mole-hill.
—आखूत्थ (˚खु-उत्˚), अस्, m. the rising up or appear-
ance of rats or moles, a swarm of rats or moles.
